$comment: W42 G0 instrument: the tolerances clause 2 requires G0 to declare BEFORE the proofs run.
Committed before any proof output exists (git history is the timestamp). Each bar is no looser than
what the grounding readers achieved (charter clause 2): memo C recovered lam and w to +-0.03 and widths
to +-0.05 CSS px at the quantisation floor (rms 0.40-0.42); memo B recovered widths within 3-10 % and
the share within 0.03-0.1 at 2x on vitrea's captures; memo E recovered k to three decimals at rms
0.40-0.42 and separated the wrong reading by >= 2.60 codes and the wrong unit by >= 4.65; memo C's
two-sided control read the mirror statistic <= 0.024 at p >= 8.
A reader that misses its bar in proof 1 or proof 3 does not read Apple (clause 2's stop). A parameter

synthetic_render.quantisation: y = round(T(M) + U(-0.5, 0.5)), clipped to 0..255 (memo C / memo E's convention)

proof1_family_recovery.discrete choices (support, edge mode, C-: the true choice's pooled rms at the floor (<= 0.45) and every wrong choice >= 0.10 code worse pooled

model reader (memo C).scope: cells whose narrow width is flat in depth (receded, and active t = 0); on depth-graded cells it reads an effective width, reported, not gated

pitch-64 heavy reader.support call: the true support ranks first wherever the supports differ by > 0.05 code rms

ESF reader (memo B).sigma: within 3 % of the rendered effective narrow width

step reader (family D).support and edge-mode call: the true one ranks first wherever they differ by > 0.05 code rms

rule: For a truth family A and a fitted family B: B is fitted to A's quantised synthetic render by least
squares, then refined by minimax on the region statistics (regions.py) of A's exact render.
s = max over cells and region statistics of |B's statistic - A's statistic| at that optimum.
DISTINGUISHED if s > 1.5 codes (B fails clause 6's max(1 code, bar) with room for the median's own
0.5-code quantisation); UNRESOLVED if s < 0.5 (B survives on A's truth); MARGINAL between, where the
verdict depends on the measured bar. An unresolved or marginal pair is a bed question and is
reported with the cell or family that would separate it.

$comment: The parent's revised ruling 3 (2026-09-29): in the ACTIVE pose refraction is taken to act AFTER the blur
(the blurred image displaced inside the band; vitrea's own order), so every active reader and family fitter
uses the narrow-support mask d >= 20 + 2 sigma_n,ref. The rival order, BEFORE the blur (the capture displaced,
then blurred), is declared with this test, which the bed decides on Apple's pixels; if the rival wins, active
fits fall back to the 2 sigma_w mask (the record in 9c1623b4 / be700896 is that fallback). Declared before
its proof runs.
statistic: Fit the law (LT, or the surviving family) on the active cells at the narrow-support mask, as the gated fit
does, and take the per-pixel luma residual e = y - y_hat. Bin the mask's pixels by depth: [d_in, 30),
[30, 38), [38, 46), [46, 54), [54, inf) pt. Per cell, NEAR is the shallowest bin with >= 200 px and FAR
the deepest, with FAR's lower edge at least 16 pt deeper than NEAR's (a cell without such a pair does not
vote). Delta_c = rms(e | NEAR) - rms(e | FAR). D = median of Delta_c over the structured cells of a pose
(families B, B', C, D, E) minus the median of Delta_c over its uniform cells (family A, the same shapes):
the uniform cells carry every depth trend that does not depend on backdrop structure (level, lift, an
unmodelled edge term), which a displacement of a uniform backdrop cannot produce.

decision.BEFORE: D > 0.30 code, carried by at least 3 structured cells with Delta_c > 0.30
decision.undecided: between: reported; the fallback is not triggered, the parent rules

proof: Synthetic renders of both orders on the active cells of the declared bed, through the memo C T stand-in,
quantised +-0.5. AFTER: the law's own render (a displacement after the blur leaves every pixel beyond the
band untouched). BEFORE: the floored capture displaced, then blurred by the law; the displacement is the
proof's stand-in for a lens whose form the dump declares only by its inputs (inner amount -min(s/2, 60),
height min(s/4, 20); outer reach max(16, s/5)): along the SDF normal, A (1 - |d| / h)^2 inside the 20-pt
inner band and outside to the 19.2-pt outer reach, pointing inward, for A in {2, 4, 8, 16} pt.
Bar: AFTER reads D < 0.15 in both active endpoints; the test's resolution is the smallest A at which BEFORE
reads D > 0.30 (reported, not a pass condition: a weak lens before the blur is harmless to the fit).
v1_result: The statistic declared first (the MEDIAN of Delta_c over structured cells) has no power on this bed: its
proof (refraction_order.v1.txt) reads D between -0.007 and +0.022 for BEFORE up to A = 16 pt in both active
endpoints, although the law's pooled rms rises from 0.41 to 0.58-0.64 code there. Contamination before the
blur is confined to the few cells whose band carries structure the deeper body does not (a step or patch
near the edge, pitch-64 squares); a displaced fine periodic pattern keeps its local mean, so the median
cell is untouched. Superseded, before its own proof ran, by the tail statistic below.
statistic_v2: Per cell, Delta_c as declared above. D_tail = mean of the 3 largest Delta_c over the structured cells minus
the mean of the 3 largest over the uniform cells (the same shapes and pose). The tail is where a
contamination large enough to move a fit lives; the uniform tail subtracts depth trends a displacement

decision_v2.undecided: between: reported; the fallback is not triggered, the parent rules

v2_disclosure_2026-09-30: The review of b151aff4 (finding I-1): the v1 proof's own record (refraction_order.v1.txt, its 'carry' counts)
showed 4 light and 3 dark structured cells with Delta_c > 0.30 at a 16-pt lens and none at 8 pt or less.
Those counts were known when the tail form was chosen in cb490956, and they already fixed the tail
statistic's outcome at the same 0.30 bar: the v2 proof confirmed what was known when v2 was declared. Its
timing is clean (cb490956 precedes its proof in 04163eec; .v1.json holds no D_tail), its power was not
news. The v2 proof also measured sensitivity only: it never rendered a wrong family without a lens.

$comment: Declared before its proof runs (the review of b151aff4, finding I-1, and the parent's disposition). The
v2 test is not specific: a declared rival rendered in the AFTER order with no lens at all and fitted by
LT reads D_tail +0.32 (W-tails, light; BEFORE), +0.27 (LT-2k, light; undecided) and +1.61 (LT+bleed, dark;
BEFORE), because any unmodelled structure-dependent term that is larger near the band reads as the
BEFORE order's signature. Memo E's LT sits at 2.1-3.5 codes pooled on Apple's cells, where no v2 proof
row lies. v3 keeps the v2 statistic, adds a second, lens-matched one, measures both legs, and makes the
call conditional on the fitted family's residual.
fit: The test family F (LT, or the family that survives clause 6) is fitted as the gated fit is: both scales
(2x and 1x), families A, B, B', C, D and E, calibration and validation roles, at the narrow-support mask,
least squares with lam inner per endpoint. P = F's pooled rms (bed-wide, equal weight per cell) is recorded.
voters: Only 2x cells vote. The 1x cells enter the fit and never vote: a 1x depth bin holds a quarter of the
pixels, and memo E's 1x p4-p8 aliasing misfit (up to 9 codes) is graded in depth under the o-law, a depth
trend that no refraction order produces.

statistics.S1: D_tail exactly as statistic_v2 over the voting cells; BEFORE > 0.30 code, AFTER < 0.15, undecided between.
S2: The lens projection A_hat. Per voting structured cell, the regressor R_c = y_before(A_ref) - y_after: F's
render at its fitted point with the proof's stand-in lens applied to the capture before every blur, less
the same render without it, on the cell's mask (luma), A_ref = 8 pt. beta = sum_c <e_c, R_c> / sum_c
<R_c, R_c> with e_c the cell's luma residual, pooled over the voting structured cells (a uniform cell has
R_c = 0). A_hat = A_ref * beta, in pt of the stand-in lens. BEFORE if A_hat >= 8 pt, AFTER if A_hat < 4 pt,

legs.sensitivity: an LT truth with the stand-in lens before the blur at A in {2, 4, 8, 16} pt, and the AFTER render (A = 0)
specificity: every declared rival family (families.FAMILIES, status rival, the dump-literal bleed forms included) rendered
in the AFTER order at its declared truth parameters with NO lens, quantised +-0.5 as every proof is; F = LT
fitted; each row records P, S1 and S2. The k-nesting rival (k shared across poses) is not a per-endpoint

validity (the conditional call): For each statistic, P*_S = the smallest P among specificity rows where S reads other than AFTER (S1: D_tail
>= 0.15; S2: A_hat >= 4 pt). If every specificity row reads AFTER, P*_S = the largest P in the leg: beyond
the leg's range a call is an extrapolation. A statistic whose sensitivity leg reads BEFORE at no A <= 16 pt
has no power and is never admitted. On a reading (Apple's pixels in G2), a statistic is ADMITTED only when
F's P there is below its P*_S.
call: S1's call if S1 is admitted; else S2's if S2 is admitted; if both are admitted and one reads BEFORE while the
other reads AFTER, UNDECIDED. If neither is admitted the call is UNDECIDED: the parent takes the refraction
order to the user before G2 fits the active pose, and neither the primary nor the fallback mask is chosen
by a statistic that cannot decide. A BEFORE or undecided call goes to the parent as before.
reported: per statistic: its resolution (the smallest A reading BEFORE), P*_S, and whether P*_S exceeds 2.1 codes,
the low end of memo E's LT pooled rms on Apple's cells (the level at which LT, as F, would read Apple).

gated: every family fitter (LT and the rivals)
the step reader's support / edge-mode call
